title: Panther in the Market
style: Phonk with sneaky bounce, midtempo and syncopated, built on dusty bass, beatboxed clicks, and handclap snaps; verse rides sparse drums and vocal percussion, pre-chorus tightens with harmonic stacks and filtered chant, chorus hits with layered singers as backing instruments and playful Spanish-English callouts. Ad-libs ping wide, risers and reversed swells bridge sections, mix stays gritty, punchy, and close-mic, comedy
lyrics:
[Intro]
Mm-mm, hey
Sss-shh, oya
(Go low)
Ayo, vámonos

[Verse 1]
I slide by the stall with a grin
One eye on the fish, one on the tin
Mama sees me, says, “What you want?”
I point at the bread like I own the font
Sneaky feet, soft like a cat
Corn on my arm, who does that?
“Bro, you serious?” — “Sí, claro”
I’m gone like smoke, then I’m back tomorrow

[Pre-Chorus]
Step light
Talk nice
Eyes on me
Then I’m gone twice
(Back up, back up)
Hear that grin?
(Back up, back up)
Let the trouble begin

[Chorus]
Panther in the market
Panther in the market
I move, you miss it
Panther in the market
(oye)
Panther in the market
(hey, hey)
I laugh, then I vanish
Panther in the market

[Verse 2]
Uncle got jokes, “You came to rob?”
I said, “Only the drum and the job”
Beatbox pocket, tik-tik-tak
Feet on the dirt, then I double right back
Fresh plantain, cold bottle pop
Whole lane turns when I make that stop
“¿Quién es ese?” — “Ese soy yo”
Too much shine for a simple show

[Pre-Chorus]
Step light
Talk nice
Eyes on me
Then I’m gone twice
(Back up, back up)
Hear that grin?
(Back up, back up)
Let the trouble begin

[Chorus]
Panther in the market
Panther in the market
I move, you miss it
Panther in the market
(oye)
Panther in the market
(hey, hey)
I laugh, then I vanish
Panther in the market

[Bridge]
Mm-hm, look at me slip through the day
Sweet talk, then I drift away
Harmonic high, low growl below
One little wink and I steal the show
(Shh, shh)
No chase, just glide
(Shh, shh)
All style, no hide

[Final Chorus]
Panther in the market
Panther in the market
I move, you miss it
Panther in the market
(oye)
Panther in the market
(hey, hey)
I laugh, then I vanish
Panther in the market
